---
title: "metaXpress meta-analysis report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
params:
  meta_result: NULL
  de_results: NULL
  studies: NULL
  padj_threshold: 0.05
  lfc_threshold: 0
  top_n: 25
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
library(metaXpress)
res <- params$meta_result
de  <- params$de_results
mt  <- res@meta_table
set <- attr(mt, "settings")
fmt <- function(x, d = 3) formatC(x, digits = d, format = "g")
```

# Methods

Per-study differential expression results from `r length(de)` studies were
combined with the **`r res@method`** method in metaXpress
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("metaXpress"))`.
`r if (!is.null(set) && res@method == "random_effects") sprintf("Between-study variance was estimated by %s%s. ", set$tau_method, if (isTRUE(set$hksj)) " with the Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman adjustment" else "")`
Genes measured in at least `r if (is.null(set)) 2 else set$min_studies` studies
were analysed (n = `r nrow(mt)`). P-values were adjusted across genes with the
Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. Significance: meta FDR <= `r params$padj_threshold`
and |log2FC| >= `r params$lfc_threshold`.

# Studies

```{r studies}
st <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(de), function(nm) {
  d <- de[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    study     = nm,
    n_case    = if ("n_case" %in% names(d)) d$n_case[1] else NA,
    n_control = if ("n_control" %in% names(d)) d$n_control[1] else NA,
    genes     = nrow(d),
    DEG_FDR05 = sum(d$padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    method    = if ("method" %in% names(d)) d$method[1] else NA)
}))
knitr::kable(st, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fold-change concordance

A negative correlation indicates a flipped case/control contrast.

```{r concordance}
knitr::kable(suppressWarnings(mx_study_concordance(de)), digits = 3,
             row.names = FALSE)
```

# Meta-analysis results

```{r summary}
sig <- !is.na(mt$meta_padj) & mt$meta_padj <= params$padj_threshold &
  abs(mt$meta_log2FC) >= params$lfc_threshold
```

`r sum(sig)` genes were significant (`r sum(sig & mt$meta_log2FC > 0)` up,
`r sum(sig & mt$meta_log2FC < 0)` down). Median I² among significant genes:
`r fmt(stats::median(mt$i_squared[sig], na.rm = TRUE))`%.

```{r volcano}
print(mx_volcano(res, padj_threshold = params$padj_threshold,
                 lfc_threshold = params$lfc_threshold))
```

```{r top}
top <- mt[order(mt$meta_pvalue), ][seq_len(min(params$top_n, nrow(mt))),
  intersect(c("gene_id", "meta_log2FC", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "pi_lower",
              "pi_upper", "meta_padj", "i_squared", "n_studies",
              "direction_consistency"), names(mt))]
knitr::kable(top, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Top genes by meta-analysis p-value")
```

## Heterogeneity

```{r het}
print(mx_heterogeneity_plot(res))
```

## Forest plots of the top genes

```{r forest, fig.height = 3.2}
for (g in head(top$gene_id, 4)) print(mx_forest(g, de, res))
```

```{r loo, results = "asis"}
if (length(de) >= 3) {
  cat("## Leave-one-out robustness\n\n")
  loo <- suppressMessages(mx_sensitivity(de, method = res@method))
  rob <- attr(loo, "robustness")
  rob <- rob[!is.na(rob$full_padj) & rob$full_padj <= params$padj_threshold, ]
  cat(sprintf("Of %d significant genes, %d (%.0f%%) remained significant ",
              nrow(rob), sum(rob$frac_loo_sig == 1),
              100 * mean(rob$frac_loo_sig == 1)),
      "with the same direction after removing any single study.\n\n")
}
```

```{r pathways, results = "asis"}
pr <- res@pathway_result
if (nrow(pr) > 0) {
  cat("# Pathway enrichment\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(pr[order(pr$padj), setdiff(names(pr),
    c("leading_edge", "overlap_genes"))], 20), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE))
}
```
